# C19 — Pratyabhijñā / Recognition

## #0

Recognition is the return in which a present determination is known through the source, identity or history from which it had become estranged. The difference acquired in the passage remains. Returning is neither cancellation of what happened nor acquisition of an untouched beginning hidden behind it.

[A21 — Individuation / Recognition](../A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) **grounds** the argument. C19 keeps the return distinct from simple recollection, correct classification or the satisfaction of having an existing account confirmed. Pratyabhijñā retains its specific Śaiva source-office within this broader authorial movement.

## #1

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration.md|Dyczkowski — The Doctrine of Vibration]], pp.71–75, **sources** the distinction between memory and recognition's wider direction. Retained traces can be recalled and recomposed within a contracted field. Recognition concerns the integral self-awareness whose activity appears at contracted and expanded levels. A remembered object and recognition of the act's source relation are therefore not interchangeable achievements.

The vertical ascent/descent and horizontal movement toward/from an object preserve the return within manifestation. [C13 — Prakāśa / Vimarśa](C13-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) **grounds** the luminous/reflexive relation; [C15 — Paśu](C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) **grounds** the bounded knower whose particularity survives recognition.

This distinction becomes load-bearing in the paradigm development. A Life can remember the rules, concepts and history through which its world has been organised without yet recognising **those means as means**. [C41 — Objective Internality](C41-Objective-Internality.md) names the lived/enacted pattern of mediation. Recognition begins when the pattern through which things have appeared self-evident can itself become available within the relation—without the explicit account of that pattern being substituted for the Life or World it mediates.

## #2

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md|Taylor — Core Theorems]] **grounds** the native return-switch. The achieved `1/0` turns toward the ground it presupposes and meets what it cannot exhaust as a further object. The `X/x` relation retains a locally real instance; its recognition does not replace the instance with a largest or final determining image.

[C06 — Copula](C06-Copula-Identification-with-Difference.md) **defines** identity through difference. The passage from `x` through `X` and back to `x` returns to a particular life with a changed relation to its determining capacity. Enlarged understanding does not require a person to cease being this person.

The same law prevents “paradigm recognition” from meaning possession of a master schema. A diagram of the paradigm is another `1`; its value lies in making relations within the means available for comparison and return. The crossed-zero movement matters because `Ø/X` recognises mediation as mediation and `(0/Ø)/(1/X)` makes both sides of the relation available together. Recognition is therefore a changed relation to the means of world-disclosure, not the installation of a final meta-model above them.

## #3

Frank's protected encounter with [[symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors.md|Van Eenwyk — Archetypes and Strange Attractors]], pp.69–73, **sources** the known→unknown→known movement. A symbol carries the person beyond the organisation in which it was first understood and returns with that organisation changed. The source's copied quotations remain leads; the native QL cross-reading belongs to Frank's encounter.

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md|Taylor — Symbolon Dynamics]] **extends** the reciprocal transformation. A symbol changes the interpreter, and the changed interpreter alters what later symbolic encounters can do. Recognition is not the instant at which all future images become fixed; it changes the conditions of their future intelligibility.

This is precisely the dynamical form of paradigm change the essay needs. A paradigm is not revised because one statement about it has been edited. Its return is real when the changed understanding alters salience, interpretation, permission, response, relation or the attractor field through which a later encounter is organised. The explicit articulation is therefore a **carrier of recognition** when it participates in this changed future; otherwise it remains a description of a paradigm rather than a recognised paradigm.

## #4

[[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD|Arbitration / Hybris / Regard / Anamnesis]] **grounds** **Resolution-in-Reconciliation → Anamnesis / Recognition / Return** at register3. A determination can be retained, narrowed or resituated through its history. Retrieving that history neither reinstalls its authority unchanged nor pretends the earlier cycle never happened.

[C34 — Individuation](C34-Individuation.md) **extends** the long psychic movement. Greek anamnesis, Śaiva pratyabhijñā and Jungian individuation retain distinct histories and evidence. Their shared operation is argued through changed relation and return; no shared word or image proves doctrinal identity.

The six-product field gives recognition differentiated destinations rather than one abstract “feedback” channel. [Central](../products/S0-Central.md) can recognise a source, commitment or history differently; [Actuation](../products/S1-Actuation.md), the conditions of an act; [AIKit](../products/S2-AIKit.md), the actual horizon of powers rather than the imagined inventory; [Factory](../products/S3-Software-Factory.md), a transformed intention or form; [Workcell](../products/S4-Workcell.md), the material situation and resistance previously treated as background; [QL](../products/S5-Quaternal-Logic.md), a containing relation within which a local distinction acquires another scale. Recognition need not change every office. It must reach the office whose inherited determination is being returned.

## #5→0

The return must reach an act. [C47 — Deferential Intelligence](C47-Deferential-Intelligence.md) **tests** whether an encounter revises the model, evaluator or course through which a result becomes consequential. A system that accepts only recognition of its own correctness closes the route it claims to complete.

[C43 — Computational Vimarśa](C43-Computational-Vimarsa.md) supplies the narrower functional test: what changed, where did the returned difference land, and what later act inherited it? [C51 — Logos / Epi-Logos](C51-Logos-Epi-Logos.md) owns the stronger paradigm-level return: an achieved articulation of the pattern becomes answerable to the lived pattern it articulates and can help revise it. C19 names the recognitive movement joining these without collapsing their registers. Functional return can be observed without settling prakāśa; paradigm-level recognition can be real without making the paradigm's explicit model exhaustive.

C19 **returns-to** C15 and A21: the bounded life remains particular, the achieved form retains its history, and the source relation becomes available in the next encounter. The result can be released into another's use. Recognition changes the relation through which the known will next meet what it cannot yet contain.

**Depth Restoration:** memory/recognition distinction, contraction's return, native x→X→x, known→unknown→known, reciprocal interpreter change, resolution-in-reconciliation, paradigm recognition, differentiated product return and practical release are restored.

**Unresolved Delta:** selected-edition collation remains pending for Dyczkowski and Van Eenwyk's copied note passages. Cross-tradition recollection/awakening/reconciliation distinctions require their own passages wherever expanded. No technical or contemplative outcome is guaranteed by arranging an account in the right form; paradigm recognition requires demonstrated changed relation rather than declared self-knowledge.

The [Indian philosophy companion](../../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/indian-philosophy/DEVELOPMENT.md#4--recognition-returns-through-the-life-that-has-become-finite) **historicises** the difference between recollection and recognitive return through Dyczkowski’s source-local account, and **compares** E2’s Resolution-in-Reconciliation without identifying Sanskrit recognition with Greek anamnesis.
